items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I would compare Oscar to, I would say that he played along the lines of Joe Benuti in those days.

ctx.x: Is there anybody that Oscar Marco played like? Anybody that compared with him?

Yes, I would compare Oscar to, I would say that he played along the lines of Joe Benuti in those days. He played that similar type of jazz. I mean, he played a real nice, hot style of violin. Something that you don't hear too much, you know. He played definitely along, I would say definitely along the lines of Joe Benuti. As much as I can remember.
Back to the piano players, are there any others that you remember in that era that were outstanding?
